questions.question: Five people Amanda, Ben, Carol, David, and Emily are sitting on a circular table facing towards the center. Carol sits in between Ben and David. Emily sits to the left of Amanda. Amanda and David are not neighbours. Who sits to the immediate right of Amanda?
questions.solution:
According to the given information,

1) Carol sits in between Ben and David.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a9d9c0879fa266f43ae9b7fc99b72a465c7e1db3d559d2a6efcd1b1bf4b4b2a.png] 

2) Emily sits to the left of Amanda.

3) Amanda and David are not neighbours.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fdc511b23614d9fd9ca00919da7b58dd04035efb9aa88ec87dc58799f2a440bb.png] 

Here, we can see that Ben sits to the immediate right of Amanda.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Ben"**.

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements. 

**Statements: **

I. All W are C. 

II. Some P are W. 

**Conclusion: **

I. Some C are P. 

II. No P is C.

IlI. Some C are W.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follows
Both conclusion I and III follows
Both conclusions I and II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram is shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d5abe5b033033894b64fa0c99b41b091e13b25604ce3701f2f9f737fbfc1e54.png] 

Conclusion: 

I. Some C are P → **True** (All W are C and some P are W implies that some C are definitely P).

II. No P is C → **False** (All W are C and some P are W implies that some P are definitely C).

IlI. Some C are W →** True** (All W are C implies that atleast some C are definitely W).

Hence, the correct answer is **"Both conclusion I and III follows"**.

questions.question: Seven friends A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are sitting around a circular table facing away from the centre. D is sitting to the immediate right of G. A sits exactly between C and E. B sits to the immediate left of F. G and C are not neighbours. E sits adjacent to D. Who sits to the immediate right of F?
questions.solution:
Given: Seven friends A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are sitting around a circular table facing away from the centre.

1) D is sitting to the immediate right of G.

2) E sits adjacent to D.

3) A sits exactly between C and E.

4) B sits to the immediate left of F.

5) G and C are not neighbours. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4decc154a875475f686dff043b7bd802f39bc2be5693a2ac21ba0b160437ff0e.png] 

So, 'G' sits to the immediate right of F.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
